views.name: patient_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Patient.ID AS id,
  Patient.SEX AS sex,
  Patient.Birthday AS birthday,
  Patient.Admission AS admission,
  Patient."First Date" AS first_date,
  Patient.Diagnosis AS diagnosis
FROM Patient
views.description: Canonical per-patient row with demographic and administrative attributes normalized for filtering and grouping.
validated_on: List the patient ID, sex and birthday of patient with LDH beyond normal range.

views.name: patient_admission_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  patient_core.id AS id,
  patient_core.sex AS sex,
  CASE
    WHEN patient_core.admission IS NULL OR TRIM(patient_core.admission) = '' THEN 'unknown'
    WHEN patient_core.admission = '+' THEN 'inpatient'
    WHEN patient_core.admission = '-' THEN 'outpatient'
    ELSE lower(patient_core.admission)
  END AS admission_category
FROM patient_core
views.description: Cohort of patients with explicit admission status categories (in-patient vs outpatient) and canonical admission flag; one row per patient per admission category. Useful for counting/grouping patients by admission type.

views.name: examination_by_patient
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Examination."ID" AS id,
  Examination."Examination Date" AS examination_date,
  Examination."Diagnosis" AS diagnosis,
  Examination."Thrombosis" AS thrombosis,
  Examination."Symptoms" AS symptoms,
  Examination."aCL IgG" AS aCL_IgG,
  Examination."aCL IgM" AS aCL_IgM,
  Examination."ANA" AS ANA,
  Examination."ANA Pattern" AS ana_pattern,
  Examination."KCT" AS kct,
  Examination."RVVT" AS rvvt,
  Examination."LAC" AS lac
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Patient."ID" = Examination."ID"
views.description: Denormalized relation joining patients to their examinations, exposing examination date and key lab/diagnosis/symptom flags. One row per examination event per patient; useful for analyses that combine patient demographics with exam findings or temporal filters.

views.name: patient_basic_demographics
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id AS ID,
  sex AS sex,
  birthday AS birthday,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', birthday) AS INTEGER) AS birth_year
FROM patient_core
views.description: One row per patient with canonicalized basic demographics and birth year extracted for easy age/birth-year filters.
counter_examples: What is the average age of the male patient with high cholesterol?

views.name: female_patient_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Patient.ID AS ID,
  UPPER(Patient.SEX) AS sex,
  Patient.Birthday AS birthday,
  CASE
    WHEN Patient.Birthday IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS birth_year
FROM Patient
WHERE UPPER(Patient.SEX) = 'F'
views.description: Cohort view of patients with sex label normalized to uppercase and only female patients exposed; keeps birth date and birth year for downstream ratios and temporal filters.

views.name: patient_counts_by_birth_year_bucket
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Patient.ID AS id,
  Patient.SEX AS sex,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS birth_year,
  COUNT(Patient.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY Patient.SEX, CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
WHERE Patient.Birthday IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY Patient.SEX, CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER), Patient.ID
views.description: Pre-aggregated counts of patients by sex and birth year (year extracted) to speed percentage and distribution queries.

views.name: patients_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Patient.ID AS ID,
  Patient.SEX AS SEX,
  Patient.Birthday AS "Birthday",
  Patient."First Date" AS "First Date",
  Patient.Admission AS Admission,
  Patient.Diagnosis AS Diagnosis
FROM Patient
views.description: One row per patient with core demographic and status columns used for cohorting and grouping (admission status, diagnosis, sex, birthday and key dates).
validated_on: Provide IDs for male patients with ALT glutamic pylvic transaminase (GPT) that have history of ALT glutamic pylvic transaminase (GPT) exceed the normal range.

views.name: patient_admission_status
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Patient.ID AS ID,
  CASE
    WHEN Patient.Admission = '+' THEN '+'
    WHEN Patient.Admission = '-' THEN '-'
    WHEN Patient.Admission IS NULL OR TRIM(Patient.Admission) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE NULL
  END AS admission_canonical,
  CASE
    WHEN Patient.Diagnosis IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE TRIM(Patient.Diagnosis)
  END AS diagnosis_canonical
FROM Patient
views.description: Normalized admission status and canonical patient diagnosis label. Cleans common admission markers to canonical values ('+' for inpatient, '-' for outpatient, NULL/other as unknown) and trims diagnosis text.

views.name: patient_counts_by_diagnosis_and_admission
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(patient_admission_status.diagnosis_canonical, patients_core.Diagnosis) AS diagnosis_canonical,
  COALESCE(patient_admission_status.admission_canonical, patients_core.Admission) AS admission_canonical,
  COUNT(DISTINCT patients_core.ID) AS patient_count
FROM patients_core
LEFT JOIN patient_admission_status ON patient_admission_status.ID = patients_core.ID
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(patient_admission_status.diagnosis_canonical, patients_core.Diagnosis),
  COALESCE(patient_admission_status.admission_canonical, patients_core.Admission)
views.description: Pre-aggregated counts of patients by diagnosis (canonical) and admission status. Keeps counts per diagnosis x admission for quick ratio/percentage calculations.

views.name: patient_demographics_24
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Patient.ID AS ID,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(Patient.SEX)), ''), 'Unknown') AS sex,
  NULLIF(TRIM(Patient.Birthday), '') AS birthday,
  NULLIF(TRIM(Patient."First Date"), '') AS first_date,
  CASE
    WHEN Patient.Admission IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN TRIM(Patient.Admission) = '' THEN 'Unknown'
    ELSE Patient.Admission
  END AS admission,
  NULLIF(TRIM(Patient.Diagnosis), '') AS patient_diagnosis
FROM Patient

views.name: patient_examination_latest_per_patient
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Examination.ID AS ID,
  Examination."Examination Date" AS "Examination Date",
  Examination."Symptoms" AS "Symptoms",
  Examination."Diagnosis" AS "Diagnosis",
  Examination."Thrombosis" AS "Thrombosis"
FROM Examination
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    ID,
    MAX("Examination Date") AS max_examination_date
  FROM Examination
  WHERE "Symptoms" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ID
) latest ON Examination.ID = latest.ID AND Examination."Examination Date" = latest.max_examination_date
WHERE Examination."Symptoms" IS NOT NULL
views.description: For each patient, the latest examination row (by Examination Date). Exposes one row per patient with the most recent exam fields, useful when answering queries about a patient's most recent symptoms/diagnosis.

views.name: laboratory_measurements_clean
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "ID" AS patient_id,
  "Date" AS date,
  -- numeric measures normalized: ua from "UA", GOT, GPT, LDH, CRP
  CASE WHEN "UA" = '' THEN NULL ELSE "UA" END AS ua,
  CASE WHEN "GOT" = '' THEN NULL ELSE "GOT" END AS got,
  CASE WHEN "GPT" = '' THEN NULL ELSE "GPT" END AS gpt,
  CASE WHEN "LDH" = '' THEN NULL ELSE "LDH" END AS ldh,
  CASE WHEN "CRP" = '' THEN NULL ELSE "CRP" END AS crp
FROM "Laboratory"
WHERE "UA" IS NOT NULL
views.description: Laboratory measurement rows cleaned and normalized: canonical column names, typed numeric measures (NULL when missing), and date preserved. Each row is one lab measurement for a patient on a date.

views.name: patient_exam_with_age_at_event
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  e.id AS id,
  e.examination_date AS examination_date,
  p.birthday AS birthday,
  CAST((strftime('%Y', e.examination_date) - strftime('%Y', p.birthday))
       - (strftime('%m-%d', e.examination_date) < strftime('%m-%d', p.birthday)) AS INTEGER) AS patient_age_at_exam,
  p.sex AS sex,
  e.diagnosis AS examination_diagnosis,
  e.thrombosis AS examination_thrombosis
FROM examination_events e
LEFT JOIN patient_basic p
  ON e.id = p.id
grain: patient.id, examination.examination_date  -- one row per patient-examination event
views.description: Denormalized view joining patient_basic and examination_events and computing patient age at the time of each examination (integer years). One row per examination event enriched with patient attributes and computed age to enable age-based cohorts (e.g., underage at exam).

views.name: laboratory_measurements
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Laboratory.ID AS id,
  Laboratory.Date AS date,
  CASE
    WHEN Laboratory.HGB IS NOT NULL THEN Laboratory.HGB
    WHEN "HGB" IS NOT NULL THEN "HGB"
    ELSE Laboratory.HGB
  END AS hgb,
  CASE
    WHEN Laboratory.WBC IS NOT NULL THEN Laboratory.WBC
    WHEN "WBC" IS NOT NULL THEN "WBC"
    ELSE Laboratory.WBC
  END AS wbc,
  CASE
    WHEN Laboratory.RBC IS NOT NULL THEN Laboratory.RBC
    WHEN "RBC" IS NOT NULL THEN "RBC"
    ELSE Laboratory.RBC
  END AS rbc,
  CASE
    WHEN Laboratory.PLT IS NOT NULL THEN Laboratory.PLT
    WHEN "PLT" IS NOT NULL THEN "PLT"
    ELSE Laboratory.PLT
  END AS plt,
  CASE
    WHEN Laboratory.CRE IS NOT NULL THEN Laboratory.CRE
    WHEN "CRE" IS NOT NULL THEN "CRE"
    ELSE Laboratory.CRE
  END AS cre,
  CASE
    WHEN Laboratory.GLU IS NOT NULL THEN Laboratory.GLU
    WHEN "GLU" IS NOT NULL THEN "GLU"
    ELSE Laboratory.GLU
  END AS glucose,
  json_object(
    'ID', Laboratory.ID,
    'Date', Laboratory.Date,
    'GOT', Laboratory.GOT,
    'GPT', Laboratory.GPT,
    'LDH', Laboratory.LDH,
    'ALP', Laboratory.ALP,
    'TP', Laboratory.TP,
    'ALB', Laboratory.ALB,
    'UA', Laboratory.UA,
    'CRE', Laboratory.CRE,
    'WBC', Laboratory.WBC,
    'RBC', Laboratory.RBC,
    'HGB', Laboratory.HGB,
    'PLT', Laboratory.PLT,
    'CRP', Laboratory.CRP,
    'GLU', Laboratory.GLU,
    'U-PRO', Laboratory."U-PRO"
  ) AS raw_row
FROM Laboratory
views.description: Normalized laboratory measurement rows per patient visit. One row per (patient_id, lab_date) with canonical numeric columns for common lab tests. Keeps raw values for downstream filtering/aggregation.

views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "ID" AS id,
  "Date" AS date,
  "T-CHO" AS t_cho,

views.name: patient_core_59

    ELSE NULL
  END AS sex,
  Patient.Birthday AS birthday,
  CASE

  END AS birth_year,
  trim(Patient.Diagnosis) AS diagnosis

views.name: patient_gender_distribution_within_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p."birth_year" AS birth_year,
  p."diagnosis" AS diagnosis,
  p."sex" AS sex,
  COUNT(p."id") AS count_patients,
  cohort.total_in_cohort AS total_patients_in_cohort
FROM
  patient_cohort_by_birthyear_and_diagnosis p
JOIN (
  SELECT
    "birth_year",
    "diagnosis",
    COUNT("id") AS total_in_cohort
  FROM
    patient_cohort_by_birthyear_and_diagnosis
  GROUP BY
    "birth_year",
    "diagnosis"
) AS cohort
  ON cohort."birth_year" = p."birth_year"
  AND ( (cohort."diagnosis" IS NULL AND p."diagnosis" IS NULL) OR cohort."diagnosis" = p."diagnosis" )
GROUP BY
  p."birth_year",
  p."diagnosis",
  p."sex",
  cohort.total_in_cohort
views.description: Aggregated counts of patients by sex within arbitrary cohorts defined by birth_year and diagnosis. Does not hardcode cohort values; returns totals and counts per sex to compute percentages.
